review:
Royal Easter is a low-volatility BGaming slot set in a palace garden, with Fabergé eggs hidden among emerald grass on a familiar 5x3 grid with 243 ways to win. BGaming lists a 97% RTP, a 7.05 hit rate and a 500x maximum win, so the pace is steady rather than dramatic. Up to five x2 Multiplier symbols can appear on a single spin and stack together to lift payouts.

Free spins switch to pay-anywhere wins, where symbols pay regardless of position. They can be triggered naturally, bought through the Buy Bonus, or made more likely with the Chance x2 option that raises the odds of landing scatters. Play the free demo to judge the rhythm; this is a slot for players who prefer frequent small wins and a refined look over max-win chasing.
